cards.title: Boot rail
items: cmd/api never migrates — two replicas would race a startup migration; golang-migrate runs as a separate deploy step (make migrate), goose is the sanctioned alternative

boot order is sequential: config → wire-generated depgraph → pgxpool → adapters → middleware chain with otelhttp at the head → each slice's Register(r chi.Router, deps) → graceful ListenAndServe (SIGTERM drains)

cards.title: Gates + streams
items: RequireAuth answers 401 envelopes AUTH_TOKEN_INVALID; RequireRole(Admin) raises the floor with rolex.AtLeast — /healthz and /readyz sit outside the middleware
WS auth happens after the handshake: a bad ?token= closes 4001 authentication_failed before any upgrade completes; SSE teardown rides r.Context()
shutdown drains in-flight handlers, then cancels baseCtx so SSE/WS pumps see ctx.Done(); the River client drains its workers the same way

cards.title: Explicit endings
items: readyz pings the pool through PgBouncer with a 2s timeout and answers a 503 {degraded} envelope — since migrations never run at startup, drift shows up here, loudly
config validation at boot fails in 200ms (required keys, known placeholder refusal) rather than at first use
Prometheus /metrics and RequestID → Logger(slog) → Recover middleware ride the same chain; OpenTelemetry ships the spans
